items.subject: personnel_gowning_operations
items.statement: Cleanroom classified area must be ISO Class 5 or as specified in batch record
items.supporting_quote: Cleanroom classified area (ISO Class 5 or as specified in batch record)

items.subject: personnel_gowning_and_aseptic_technique
items.statement: Verify equipment calibration, complete environmental monitoring, review and sign BMR, perform gowning and aseptic technique, record parameters in real time, collect in-process samples, report deviations immediately, clean and sanitize equipment upon completion
items.supporting_quote: 5.1 Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits. 5.2 Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification. 5.3 Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations. 5.4 Perform personnel gowning and aseptic technique according to the approved batch record instructions. 5.5 Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time. 5.6 Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing. 5.7 Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-5351-60. 5.8 Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-3144-95.
items.trigger_conditions: ["Prior to commencing personnel gowning and aseptic technique operations"]
